title: Events as Triggers for Behavioral Diversity in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.12388v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Effective multi-agent cooperation requires agents to adopt diverse behaviors as task conditions evolve-and to do so at the right moment. Yet, current Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) frameworks that facilitate this diversity are still limited by the fact that they bind fixed behaviors to fixed agent identities. Consequently, they are ill-equipped for tasks where agents need to take on different roles at very specific moments in time. We argue that, to define these behavioral transitions, the missing ingredient is $\textbf{events}$. Events are changes in the state of the system that induce qualitative changes in the task. Based on this view, we introduce a framework that decouples agent identity from behavior, capturing a continuous manifold from which agents instantiate their behaviors in response to events. translated_title: 事件作为多智能体强化学习中行为多样性的触发器
translated_abstract: 有效的多智能体协作要求智能体随着任务条件的演变采取多样化的行为——并且要在恰当的时机做到这一点。然而，当前促进这种多样性的多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架仍然受限于将固定行为绑定到固定智能体身份这一事实。因此，它们难以胜任那些智能体需要在非常特定的时刻承担不同角色的任务。我们认为，要定义这些行为转变，所缺失的关键要素是**事件**。事件是系统状态的变化，会引发任务的质变。基于这一观点，我们引入了一个将智能体身份与行为解耦的框架，该框架捕获一个连续流形，智能体可以从中实例化自己的行为以响应事件。该框架基于两个要素：首先，为了构建一个富有表现力的行为流形，我们引入了神经马……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出以“事件”作为行为转变的触发器，通过将智能体身份与行为解耦并构建连续行为流形的框架，使多智能体强化学习中的智能体能够在特定时刻响应事件动态切换角色和行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using "events" as triggers for behavioral transitions and introduces a framework that decouples agent identity from behavior via a continuous behavior manifold, enabling MARL agents to dynamically switch roles and behaviors at specific moments in response to events.
